name: Historic Quarter of the Seaport City of Valparaíso
description: Valparaíso is a Pacific port city in central Chile, about 120 km northwest of Santiago. Its brightly painted houses and church spires climb a ring of steep hills above the bay like an amphitheatre. Century-old funicular "elevators" still haul people up the slopes, and wandering the cobbled alleys is the main attraction. In the 19th century, ships rounding South America made it a bustling stopover.
